2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch removes the `mem_cgroup_shrink_node()` function, which was only called by soft limit reclaim and has since been removed. The function is no longer needed as it served a specific purpose that is no longer relevant. The removal of this function simplifies the code and reduces complexity. The patch also includes the deletion of related code from `mm/vmscan.c` and the removal of the function declaration from `mm/internal.h`. This change is part of a larger series of patches aimed at cleaning up and improving memory cgroup functionality.
